Only 15 states in the US require 9/11 education, and New Jersey is not one of them. I find that totally unacceptable.

That’s why I introduced new legislation that will require every school across the country to teach our students, our future leaders, the history of what happened on that tragic day.

text:
Market forces failed to provide seat belts in cars. Or advanced airbags.

Market forces failed to provide safe drugs.

Market forces failed to prevent acid rain.

That’s why the federal government regulates vehicles, drugs and power plants.

Why should AI be exempt? It shouldn’t. https://t.co/9x35iIKfmO

quoted.text:
Jensen Huang: “Safety is paramount. In a lot of ways, it’s job one. However, safety is an engineering problem... If we’re not confident about the safety of the products — like all companies, like you and I, all the companies here — if you build a product or a service and you’re not confident in its functionality, capability, or safety, then don’t release it.
That’s a very obvious thing to do. You pace yourself until you are confident you’re releasing something that the market would appreciate. The market forces are already there. We don’t need any new laws. We don’t need new regulations.” https://t.co/5Lz4RIQbtV
